question: Which nature reserve can be found within 90 kilometers while moving west from English Street Community Garden, New Haven, CT?
sql:
WITH origin AS  (SELECT ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-72.896423 41.316453)',4326)::geography AS geometry)
SELECT * FROM pois, origin
WHERE ST_DWithin(pois.geometry, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-72.896423 41.316453)',4326)::geography, 90000)
AND leisure = 'nature_reserve'
AND degrees(ST_Azimuth(origin.geometry, pois.geometry)) BETWEEN 247.5 AND 292.5;

answers.operator: Connecticut Department of Energy and Environmental Protection

[3].display_name: English Street Community Garden, New Haven, CT
